These fixtures contain only the factual report-board excerpts used by the parsers, retrieved on 2026-10-18 in Japan. Missing off-season snow values remain missing. Tests modify copies to exercise winter values and invalid responses; those generated values are not resort observations.

- `rusutsu-snow.html`: the first `.weather-wrap` from https://rusutsu.com/en/snow-and-weather-report/ . The source prints a day/month/year timestamp and identifies West Mt. The 24-hour snowfall field is separate from accumulated snow depth.
- `rusutsu-lifts.json`: only `other` and `lift` from https://rusutsu.com/assets/partial/ajax/trail-and-lift/get-front.php . The resort's public https://rusutsu.com/assets/js/front/lift-and-trail-status/index.js uses `other.update` as a Unix timestamp. Its `index.partial/output-lift.js` maps explicit Japanese operating states to localized labels. This captured update is from April 2, 2026 JST; fetching it in October does not make it current.
- `madarao-snow.html`: `.bar-condition-inner` from https://www.madarao.jp/ski . The source names `降雪（24H）` explicitly and prints its report date and AM/PM time. No station height is supplied. Its lift table says `リフト運行予定` (schedule), so the adapter does not use it as a current operating report.
